caption: The video captures a hazy orange-red sunset with mountain ridges silhouetted across the middle. Below it, a faint skyline of blocks and a thin plume stands in haze, with a gantry silhouette at the bottom. Throughout, the scene drifts leftward as the camera pans right, carrying the peak, buildings, plume, and gantry toward the left edge. The gantry and leftmost ridges slide out of view. The buildings and plume keep shifting left. As the pan continues, the yellow-white sun glow at the horizon grows dominant on the right, brightening into a luminous bloom flooding the right sky.
relations: As the camera pans right, the mountain ridges, buildings, plume, and gantry drift leftward toward the edge.
The rightward pan causes the horizon's yellow-white sun glow to grow dominant, brightening into a luminous bloom.
